bio: At the Häfliger family's lovely 100-year-old restaurant, diners can look forward to fresh, flavoursome food and attentive service provided by experienced staff. Classic Swiss cuisine is served in the form of a seasonal or surprise set menu. Alternatively, you can order à la carte. This place even has its own excellent spring water! Pleasant terrace to the rear of the building. Tip: Delicious cheese is sold in the cheesery next door....
